name: How long does finish carpentry work take during a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: How long does finish carpentry work take during a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a typical residential bathroom, finish carpentry usually takes between one and three days to complete. Simple projects involving baseboard replacement, door casing, and mounting a pre-made vanity can be wrapped up in a single day. More complex projects—such as installing custom built-in linen towers, tongue-and-groove accent walls, or multi-piece crown molding—require two to three days for precise cuts, fastening, caulking, and finish painting. Project lead Abraham Becerra coordinates these carpentry steps alongside our drywall and painting schedule to prevent idle downtime.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most bathroom finish carpentry projects take between one and three days, depending on the complexity of moldings and custom cabinetry.
